full_prompt_en: A square dark mixed-media portrait shows a pale woman facing forward with her chin slightly lifted. Two dark curled horns frame her head beneath a rough crown of dull gold leaves and debris. Long light hair falls over her shoulders, and a stained white veil or cloth wraps around the sides of the face. Behind her head sits a large cracked ivory disk, like an aged halo, against a deep rusty red wall. The lips are full and softly colored, while the eyes look directly outward beneath heavy shadow. Her neck and shoulders emerge from mottled warm-brown darkness at the bottom. The portrait combines carefully modeled skin with collage-like scratches, scraped paint, fragmented gold pieces, and weathered printed texture. Red-orange marks scatter around the disk, making the surface feel old and damaged rather than pristine. Light comes from above and slightly left, catching the forehead, nose, lips, and gold fragments while horns and lower corners stay dark. The centered frontal placement feels ceremonial and confrontational. There is little spatial depth beyond the layered disk and wall; material texture supplies much of the complexity. The overall image is lush but unsettling, blending sacred portrait structure with gothic theatrical details and a visibly distressed surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形深色混合媒介肖像描绘一位浅色女子正面朝外，下巴略抬。两只深色卷角围住她的头，头顶还有暗金叶片与碎物构成的粗冠。长浅发垂过肩，染污白纱或布包在脸两侧。头后有一块大型裂纹象牙色圆盘，像经年光环，立于深锈红墙前。唇丰满而柔和着色，眼从浓影下直接望出。颈与肩从下方斑驳暖棕暗处浮起。肖像把仔细塑形的皮肤与拼贴般划痕、刮擦颜料、碎金片和风化印纹结合。红橙痕散在圆盘周围，使表面陈旧破损，而不洁净。光从略左上来，照亮额、鼻、唇与金碎片，角和下方角落保持暗色。中央正面安排庄严且带对峙感。除圆盘和墙的层叠外几乎没有空间纵深；物质肌理承担大部分复杂度。整体华美却不安，把圣像结构与哥特戏剧细节和可见破损表面融在一起。
style_prompt_en: Dark mixed-media portraiture combines smooth focal modeling with scraped collage texture, cracked circular grounds, and tarnished metallic fragments. Ivory, rust red, black-brown, and muted gold form a rich antique palette. A centered pale form emerges from deep shadows while horn-like dark curves and a rough halo structure add tension. Upper-side light catches raised skin and metallic scraps; lower areas stay mottled and obscure. Edges alternate between precise anatomy and torn or eroded marks. Shallow layered depth, frontal symmetry, and distressed material give the image ceremonial gothic intensity.
style_prompt_zh: 深色混合媒介肖像把平滑焦点塑形与刮擦拼贴肌理、裂纹圆底和失光泽金属碎片结合。象牙、锈红、黑棕与低调金形成丰厚古旧配色。中央浅色形体从深影里浮出，角状深弧与粗糙光环结构增添张力。上侧光照亮凸起皮肤和金属碎片，下部保留斑驳模糊。边缘在精确结构与撕裂侵蚀痕间切换。浅层叠纵深、正面对称和磨损物质赋予画面礼仪化哥特强度。
theme_en: A pale woman beneath a cracked halo and horned headdress
theme_zh: 裂纹光环与角形头饰下的浅色女子
name: Saturno Butto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
